outcome: Circulating cytokine levels (IFN-g, IL-10, IL-17A, IL-1b, IL-6, TNF-a) in maternal and cord blood
cohort: The study utilized samples from 37 mother-infant pairs from a previously conducted maternal immunization study.
finding: Weak to moderate correlations were found between maternal and cord blood cytokine levels, with trends for lower cytokine levels observed in preterm deliveries compared to term, and in cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: A trend for lower cytokine levels was observed for cesarean section compared with vaginal delivery, but only in maternal serum samples.
